summary: Regression after code-quality refactor (App.js split into useDocIntel hook + Header/InputPanel/OutputPanel; JsonViewer rewritten to safe tokenized React nodes; backend run() split into _to_markdown/_extract_structured; security.py and extraction_pipeline.py try/except/else restructured). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (health, ready, JWT mint, sync S3 mock, multipart upload, 401/403/400/404 problem+json, async PENDING->COMPLETED). Frontend: full Playwright flow passes — health/ready badges green, JWT auto-minted (240 chars, 2 dots), sync S3 -> json-output with documentType/title/sections/fields/summary, model-badge='Mock LLM', correlation-id 'ui-...', markdown tab renders markdown text, async PENDING->COMPLETED in ~3 polls, upload dropzone & file-input present. XSS verification: json-output and markdown-output innerHTML contain NO <script> tags — JsonViewer renders all content as escaped React text nodes (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML). API contract unchanged from iteration_2.

backend: test_auth_token_mint -> JWT (2 dots), expiresIn=3600, roles include extractor
test_async_extract_and_poll_completion -> 202 PENDING -> COMPLETED with structured result
frontend: source-tab-s3 + extract-btn sync -> json-output structured JSON; model-badge='Mock LLM'; correlation-id='ui-...'
JsonViewer XSS check: innerHTML contains NO <script> for both json-output and markdown-output
mode-async + extract-btn -> job-status-badge PENDING -> COMPLETED in 3 polls; json-output renders async result

critical_code_review_comments: useDocIntel.js submit() reads JSON body via res.json() before checking res.ok; that's fine for problem+json error bodies but a malformed non-JSON 5xx would throw a Network error rather than surfacing the status. Consider try/catch around .json().
useDocIntel.js pollJob captures `token` in closure; if user re-mints the token mid-poll, the polling request will keep using the original token (carryover note from iteration_1/2). Low risk for demo.
JsonViewer TOKEN_RE is shared module-level; safe because lastIndex is reset on each tokenize() call, but worth a comment so future contributors don't move it.
MetaStrip uses navigator.clipboard?.writeText without a fallback toast/feedback; minor UX gap.

Carryovers still valid from iteration_2: build_provider() silent mock fallback (consider STRICT_PROVIDER env); LLMExtractionService._attempt retries 4xx auth errors (should be non-retryable); CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; _note string in mock payload should be debug-gated for prod.
test_credentials: Mock OIDC mint via POST /api/v1/auth/token {sub, roles:['extractor','admin']}; viewer role used for 403 test.
seed_data_creation: None (S3 mocked, LLM mock fallback as intended).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest entry: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_extraction_api.py -v. Refactor preserves API contract & UI behavior; JsonViewer is now XSS-safe (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML). For real-provider validation set LLM_PROVIDER + matching API key.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Pure code-quality refactor — component/hook extraction, helper function split, and safe JsonViewer tokenization — preserved all behavior.
